schema_objects.name: book_details
schema_objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE book_details (
            id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            book_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            section_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            topic_id INTEGER,
            topic_name VARCHAR(255),
            description TEXT,
            PRIMARY KEY (id, book_id, section_id)
        )

schema_objects.name: books
schema_objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE books (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
            writer VARCHAR(255),
            translator VARCHAR(255),
            editor VARCHAR(255)
        )

schema_objects.name: categories
schema_objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE "categories" (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    icon VARCHAR(255)
, dua_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, subcat_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0)

schema_objects.name: drawer_item_actions
schema_objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE drawer_item_actions (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    drawer_item_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    action_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    label TEXT NOT NULL,
    icon TEXT,
    url TEXT,
    action_data TEXT,
    display_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    FOREIGN KEY (drawer_item_id) REFERENCES drawer_items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

schema_objects.name: drawer_items
schema_objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE drawer_items (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    item_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    hero_title1 TEXT,
    hero_title2 TEXT,
    content TEXT NOT NULL,
    display_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    created_at INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    updated_at INTEGER DEFAULT 0
)

schema_objects.name: dua_infos
schema_objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE dua_infos (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            name VARCHAR(255),
            description TEXT
        )

schema_objects.name: duas
schema_objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE duas (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            groups JSON,
            name TEXT,
            content TEXT,
            uthmani TEXT,
            indopak TEXT,
            clean TEXT,
            transliteration TEXT,
            translation TEXT,
            note TEXT,
            reference TEXT,
            audio INTEGER,
            cat_id INTEGER,
            subcat_id INTEGER
        )

schema_objects.name: ids
schema_objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE ids (
            current_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            previous_id INTEGER NOT NULL
        )

schema_objects.name: ruqyah_categories
schema_objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE "ruqyah_categories" (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    type TEXT NOT NULL,
    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    icon VARCHAR(255)
)

schema_objects.name: ruqyah_details
schema_objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE ruqyah_details (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            topic_id INTEGER,
            topic_name VARCHAR(255),
            text TEXT,
            cat_id INTEGER,
            subcat_id INTEGER
        )

schema_objects.name: ruqyah_instants
schema_objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE ruqyah_instants (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            topic_id INTEGER,
            topic_name VARCHAR(255),
            name TEXT,
            content TEXT,
            uthmani TEXT,
            transliteration TEXT,
            translation TEXT,
            reference TEXT,
            cat_id INTEGER,
            subcat_id INTEGER
        , audio TEXT)

schema_objects.name: ruqyah_subcategories
schema_objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE ruqyah_subcategories (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            type TEXT NOT NULL,
            name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
            cat_id INTEGER
        )

schema_objects.name: ruqyah_videos
schema_objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE ruqyah_videos (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
            author VARCHAR(255),
            link_id INTEGER,
            link VARCHAR(255),
            cat_id INTEGER,
            subcat_id INTEGER
        )

schema_objects.name: sections
schema_objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE sections (
            id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            book_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (id, book_id)
        )

schema_objects.name: subcategories
schema_objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE subcategories (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
            cat_id INTEGER
        )
